Chapter ids/titles = the question bank's (textbook-verified in R1); chapter page ranges from the mechanical structure pass, all 147 chapter starts aligned to bank titles. Sections come in Phase 2 (map v2). v1.1: subject divisions added from the textbook contents pages (coordinator-read, 2026-10-11). | v2 Phase 2 (spine2-class-10-social, 2026-10-20): per-chapter `sections` added = reviewed list of main sections (standalone printed bold headings), curated against the page images from the mechanical draft soc-10-2026_sections_draft_v1.json. Run-in sub-heads, figure/table/map captions and labels, Know-this boxes, exercise blocks, numbered list items and generic list-labels dropped (see curation_notes per chapter).
